target_medium: GitHub README (web), body width about 900 px; PNG 200 dpi and SVG with editable text

style.rule: Status is shown by text labels as well as color; pending items have no bar and are labelled as not calculated.

figures.message: Stainless steel and polypropylene account for most of the calculated GWP100; six materials remain uncalculated.
figures.layout: Two aligned horizontal-bar panels sharing the BOM item rows. Left: finished mass (g). Right: GWP100 (kg CO2-eq per kettle), stacked material plus conversion. Rows sorted by GWP100; pending rows at the bottom.

figures.message: Direct emissions of the stainless steel datasets (including the value-of-scrap burden) and of containerboard and olefin production drive the calculated result.
figures.layout: Single horizontal-bar panel, top 10 supply-chain processes by direct GWP100, value labels in kg CO2-eq and share of the calculated total.
